answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7167 Country: India Title: What is the meaning of "Maulana"? To whom can we call "Maulan"? Question: What is the meaning of "Maulana"? To whom can we call "Maulan"? Answer ID: 7167 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1022/903=L/1429) Maulana means: our senior, elder, master etc, but traditionally it is called to one who is graduated from any madrasa in Islamic Sciences. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
